profile.headline: Indie dev
profile.summary: iOS Frameworks Engineer with a passion for clean code, best-practices and mission-driven work.

positions.title: Solo Game Developer
positions.description:
- Left Apple to pursue independent game development. 
- Currently developing a video game for the PC platform using Unreal Engine.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain and update Apple Music download, syncing, and library frameworks on iPhone, Watch and AppleTV

positions.title: Screening and Integration Engineer
positions.description:
• Triage, investigate, prioritize and assign bug reports to appropriate engineer or engineering team.
• Build and maintain tools to enhance triaging workflow
• Assist in the integration of the team’s components including version building and submission to main
• Work with QA to ensure improved automation test coverage and understanding of new product features.

positions.title: Animator
positions.description:
•	Designed art assets and animate informational videos, web graphics, pdfs, logos and other media
•	Worked within artistic teams to deliver client requests in budget and on time
•	Clients include State of California, Ceridian Lifeworks, Susan Love Research Foundation for Breast Cancer and various tech start-ups

positions.title: Assistant to Showrunner
positions.description:
•	Assisted EP/Showrunner during development and pilot season of 2013/2014
•	Proofread studio and network submissions of CBS pilot
•	Maintained casting office, recorded casting sessions, managed all administrative duties
•	Managed personal and professional calendar and errands

positions.title: Assistant
positions.description:
•	Supported Television Literary Agent in all administrative duties
•	Managed high-volume work load: answer phones, set meetings, compile client submissions
•	Oversaw all client financial documents, contracts and payments
•	Reviewed client and potential-client scripts, provide feedback for Agent's consideration

positions.title: Program Associate
positions.description:
•	Reviewed PBS Kids and General Audience programs to ensure compliance with legal guidelines and PBS standard of quality before national air
•	Assessed, noted and made recommendations for revisions to sensitive content
•	Supported Content Services team, including developing calendar for scheduling contracts and general administrative assistance
•	Maintained minutes for Program Management staff meetings
